semiconductor_relevance: High — Toyobo provides high-performance materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes, including low thermal expansion films and dielectric materials.
summary: Toyobo specializes in developing advanced materials that support semiconductor technology, focusing on high-precision manufacturing and next-generation communication applications. Their innovative product range includes low thermal expansion polyimide films and environmentally friendly optical materials, catering to the diverse needs of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Low thermal expansion polyimide films (Xenomax®, Xenoshine®)
Low dielectric materials for high-speed electronic components
Optical films with low refractive index
High-performance fibers for semiconductor manufacturing equipment
